name: ModelVariant135_HandleRequest
evidence: matching model_variant/variant135_entry.c: the image entry at base + 4 (48 sparks fly from one slot part to the other slot, beam crosses burst over the targets and a ribbon of grid quads sweeps between two pairs of slot parts); for a non-negative request it selects the config record indexed by the request modulo 100, seeds the spark and grid points, packs ten texture images and prints the work size, otherwise it runs one frame and returns 1 once when the sparks finish, then 2, else 4 after the ribbon wave ends or 0; Model_UpdateSlotControl calls the variant at base + 4 with the request modulo 1000 and then -1 (notes/model-structures.md)
notes: Shared name bound per image in *_symbols.txt instead of a #define remap; the same address in every bound image; the French header-152 and 282 images build it without the work-size printf, so their data names bind 0x24 lower. HandleRequest names only the request dispatch, not the effect. See notes/overlays/model-variants.md#per-image-symbol-bindings.
